استشكلنا (form X)
# اِسْتَشْكَلْنَا (istaškalnā) /is.taʃ.kal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اُسْتُشْكِلْنَا (ustuškilnā) /us.tuʃ.kil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
